prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: exactly FOUR original game animation sprites arranged 2x2, true transparent RGBA, requested native 2048x2048.
Input image 1 is exact WEST direction and same standing anatomy scale. Input image 2 is adult woman's identity/costume only; OMIT its pet/background. Produce four NEW poses, not repetitions of either reference. All four face SCREEN LEFT in leftward FRONT THREE-QUARTER view, nose, torso, knees and toes aim screen left. High angle 35 degree downward near-isometric 2.5D. Do not mirror or globally rotate.
Character CH03 Lumi age22 adult female: chestnut curly hair, full bust, definite narrow cinched waist, slender shoulders and limbs. Complete obsidian black / midnight-purple fitted mid-length witch dress, silver magic embroidery and crescents, black crescent boots, elegant compact witchhat, ornate black-silver giant star-ring/crescent staff with dark-purple crystal and tight icy-blue magical glow. Preserve warm dimensional hand-painted cartoon rendering, detailed dark cloth highlights.
Layout exactly top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right isolated sprites with transparent central gutters. Hat, staff, hem, boots and accessories fully fit their own cell with at least35 native transparent px from cell edges. Preserve original reference anatomy scale: natural hair/head top to mean boot soles450–550 REAL pixels excluding hat; no small body or huge hat. Whole character including hat below560px. Canvas native2048² requested, do not upscale after creation.
TOP LEFT BASIC_RELEASE: in west-facing planted stance, staff held upright at her side, EMPTY hand extended fully across FRONT of body toward SCREEN LEFT pointing to a target outside the sheet; command the separately rendered familiar, but NO PET in this picture. Index finger clearly leftward. Reach direction matches face.
TOP RIGHT BASIC_RECOVERY: same west-facing standing size, empty hand drawing back close to chest and weight settling, staff upright at side. Gesture is visibly different from release.
BOTTOM LEFT DASH: low body lean moving toward screen LEFT with long quick forward step, bent front knee and rear leg stretched, hair and skirt follow naturally, still holding complete ring-staff close along direction of movement. No motion trails, no blur. Make a clearly distinct compact low athletic dash silhouette without shrinking the anatomy.
BOTTOM RIGHT GUARD_CAST: both hands visibly grasp ring staff in FRONT of torso and lift it forward-left for concentrated ward casting; ring crystal near head height; elbows and hands clearly separate from recovery, slightly braced legs. No separate shield FX or broad aura, tight light within ring only.
Do not draw pet, floor, contact/cast shadow, text, labels, guide grid, background, detached FX, trails, crops or extra sprites. True transparent outside edges and empty gaps. All four WEST-facing screen LEFT, no right-facing pose.
